title: AI in Education: Reimagining Learning for Every Student
description: Artificial intelligence personalizes education with adaptive learning, automated grading, and virtual tutors, making education accessible.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in Education, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Education for teachers, school leaders, edtech teams, and readers tracking classroom change.
